## Specific task description

Task instruction: Position the medium-sized white serving bowl at the center of the smooth round plate for serving.

Task description: The object is the medium white serving bowl on the right side of the table. The target is the flat, light-colored, smooth round plate near the front and slightly toward the center. Place the white bowl in the center of the plate as a serving arrangement.

Success criteria: The white bowl is near the center of the plate horizontally and lowered to rest on its surface, not still suspended above it; both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping a clear section of the white bowl wall facing the table front, with one finger inside and one outside. Adjust the opening for wall thickness and pad space, avoiding the approach difficulties of spanning the entire mouth.
- Make contact with a section of the bowl wall just below its rim where the pads can fit fully. Before closing, confirm that the fingers are on the inside and outside of the wall rather than pressing only on the rim and slipping.
- Keep the bowl opening facing up during transport, with the base high enough to clear the plate rim. Make needed pose adjustments where there is room, avoiding an angled collision with the rim.
- Near the plate, lower slightly and leave room for the outer finger to withdraw. Release only after the bowl's base is supported by the plate, avoiding finger contact with the plate or dropping the bowl while unsupported.
